title: Potential at A
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the electric potential at point A as 6 V, using the work done from infinity and the given charge.

title: Potential at B
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the electric potential at point B as 2 V, using the potential at A and the work done from A to B.

title: Sign for Infinity to A
description: Important: Recognizes that work done by the field from infinity to A gives a negative potential difference, correctly relating it to the potential at infinity being zero.

title: Sign for A to B
description: Important: Recognizes that work done against the field from A to B gives a positive potential difference and subtracts it from the potential at A.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Explicitly shows unit analysis (J/C = V) for both potential calculations.

title: Sign Error in U_∞A
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly uses a positive sign for the potential difference from infinity to A, leading to a wrong potential at A.

title: Wrong Operation for U_AB
description: Pitfall: Adds the potential difference U_AB to φ_A instead of subtracting it, leading to an incorrect potential at B.
